title.en: China win women's short track relay gold in Seoul, first World Tour title of the season under Wu Dajing
title.zh_hans: 中国女队短道速滑接力夺金 武大靖执教首金 新赛季世巡赛开斋
title.zh_hant: 中國女隊短道速滑接力奪金 武大靖執教首金 新賽季世巡賽開齋

summary.en: China won the women's 3,000m relay gold at the ISU Short Track World Tour stop in Seoul today, the Chinese short track team's first World Tour gold of the new season and the first gold for the team under head coach Wu Dajing. Zhang Chutong, Gong Li, Zhang Yan and Zhang Jianing lined up for China in the final; a Canadian skater fell in the closing laps as China battled South Korea for the lead, and China held on to win ahead of the hosts, with South Korea taking silver and Individual Neutral Athletes bronze.
summary.zh_hans: 在今日进行的2026-2027赛季短道速滑世界巡回赛首尔站比赛中，由张楚桐、公俐、张延及张珈宁组成的中国队夺得女子3000米接力金牌，是中国短道速滑队新赛季首枚世巡赛金牌，亦是武大靖出任主教练以来带队收获的首枚金牌。决赛尾段加拿大选手摔倒，中国队与韩国队争夺金牌，最终力压韩国队夺冠，韩国队得银牌，中立运动员得铜牌。
summary.zh_hant: 在今日進行的2026-2027賽季短道速滑世界巡迴賽首爾站比賽中，由張楚桐、公俐、張延及張珈寧組成的中國隊奪得女子3000米接力金牌，是中國短道速滑隊新賽季首枚世巡賽金牌，亦是武大靖出任主教練以來帶隊收穫的首枚金牌。決賽尾段加拿大選手摔倒，中國隊與韓國隊爭奪金牌，最終力壓韓國隊奪冠，韓國隊得銀牌，中立運動員得銅牌。

title.en: Hong Kong Open: Antonsen ends Lakshya Sen's 13-match winning streak to reach final
title.zh_hans: 香港公开赛：安顿臣直落两局挫拉克什亚 终结对方13连胜晋决赛
title.zh_hant: 香港公開賽：安頓臣直落兩局挫拉克什亞 終結對方13連勝晉決賽

summary.en: India's Lakshya Sen saw his 13-match winning streak end at the Hong Kong Open men's singles semi-finals, losing 13-21, 13-21 to Denmark's world No. 3 Anders Antonsen in 42 minutes at Kai Tak Arena. Sen, who had won the Hylo Open and the Japan Masters earlier this month, was chasing a third straight title; Antonsen extended his head-to-head lead to 6-3 and will face Thailand's Kunlavut Vitidsarn or Indonesia's Mohd. Zaki Ubaidillah in Sunday's final. In the men's doubles, India's Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty lost 18-21, 19-21 to Malaysia's Man Wei Chong and Tee Kai Wun.
summary.zh_hans: 印度球手拉克什亚在香港公开赛男单四强，直落两局13比21、13比21不敌丹麦三号种子安顿臣，13连胜告终。拉克什亚今月初先后赢得德国及日本大师赛，原本冲击三连冠；安顿臣42分钟取胜后将对赛优势扩大至6比3，决赛将斗泰国的昆拉维特或印尼新星乌拜迪拉。男双方面，印度组合萨维克塞拉直落两局18比21、19比21不敌马来西亚的万纬聪／郑凯文出局。
summary.zh_hant: 印度球手拉克什亞在香港公開賽男單四強，直落兩局13比21、13比21不敵丹麥三號種子安頓臣，13連勝告終。拉克什亞今月初先後贏得德國及日本大師賽，原本衝擊三連冠；安頓臣42分鐘取勝後將對賽優勢擴大至6比3，決賽將鬥泰國的昆拉維特或印尼新星烏拜迪拉。男雙方面，印度組合薩維克塞拉直落兩局18比21、19比21不敵馬來西亞的萬緯聰／鄭凱文出局。

title.en: Jokic scores 24 after half-time as Nuggets beat Rockets 133-124 despite Sengun's triple-double
title.zh_hans: 约基奇下半场轰24分 金块133:124挫火箭 森根大三元白费
title.zh_hant: 約基奇下半場轟24分 金塊133:124挫火箭 森根大三元白費

summary.en: Nikola Jokic scored 24 of his 26 points after half-time, adding 11 assists and seven rebounds, as the Denver Nuggets beat the Houston Rockets 133-124 in an NBA Cup group game. Jokic scored 18 points in the third quarter to put Denver ahead, and the Nuggets closed the game with a 34-22 fourth quarter to improve to 2-0 in West Group A. Houston centre Alperen Sengun, who played the first quarter in goggles after suffering a scratched cornea against Indiana on Wednesday, posted 28 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists for his second triple-double of the season. Fred VanVleet scored 25 points, Amen Thompson 22, Jabari Smith Jr 21 and Kevin Durant 16 for the Rockets, who fell to 1-2.
summary.zh_hans: 尼古拉·约基奇下半场攻入24分，全场26分、11次助攻及7个篮板，带领丹佛金块在NBA杯分组赛以133:124击败侯斯顿火箭。约基奇第三节独取18分，协助金块反超；金块第四节打出34:22锁定胜局，NBA杯西岸A组2胜0负。火箭中锋艾佩伦·森根戴上护目镜上阵，交出28分、11个篮板及10次助攻大三元，今季第二次；此前他周三对溜马时角膜擦伤。云维利得25分、汤臣22分、史密斯21分、杜兰特16分，火箭1胜2负。
summary.zh_hant: 尼古拉·約基奇下半場攻入24分，全場26分、11次助攻及7個籃板，帶領丹佛金塊在NBA盃分組賽以133:124擊敗侯斯頓火箭。約基奇第三節獨取18分，協助金塊反超；金塊第四節打出34:22鎖定勝局，NBA盃西岸A組2勝0負。火箭中鋒艾佩倫·森根戴上護目鏡上陣，交出28分、11個籃板及10次助攻大三元，今季第二次；此前他周三對溜馬時角膜擦傷。雲維利得25分、湯臣22分、史密斯21分、杜蘭特16分，火箭1勝2負。

title.en: Doncic's 25 points power Lakers past Kings 106-104 after rallying from 11 down
title.zh_hans: 东契奇25分领军 湖人险胜帝王106:104 11分落后反胜
title.zh_hant: 東契奇25分領軍 湖人險勝帝王106:104 11分落後反勝

summary.en: Luka Doncic scored 25 points and dished out eight assists, and Quentin Grimes hit a tiebreaking three-pointer with 57 seconds to play, as the Los Angeles Lakers rallied in the fourth quarter to beat the Sacramento Kings 106-104 in an NBA Cup group game. The Lakers trailed by 11 points in the third quarter before turning it into an eight-point lead in the fourth, their 10th win in 11 games and a 2-1 record in West Group C. Walker Kessler scored 15 points and Matisse Thybulle added 14 for the Lakers, who were coming off the end of a nine-game winning streak in a loss to Utah. For the Kings, Domantas Sabonis had 19 points and 16 rebounds, and Zach LaVine missed a 29-foot three-pointer at the buzzer as Sacramento fell to 0-3.
summary.zh_hans: 卢卡·东契奇攻入25分及8次助攻，昆廷·格莱姆斯在完场前57秒射入反超三分球，洛杉矶湖人在NBA杯分组赛以106:104险胜萨克拉门托国王。湖人在第三节一度落后11分，第四节反扑取得领先，是近11场第10胜，NBA杯西岸C组2胜1负。获加·基斯拿得15分，马蒂斯·泰布尔得14分；球队此前九连胜刚被爵士终结。帝王方面，沙邦尼斯得19分及16个篮板，拉维利在完场一刻射失29呎三分球，帝王0胜3负。

title.en: James Harden drops 51 as Cavaliers beat Pacers 128-119, passing Kobe Bryant for third-most 50-point games
title.zh_hans: 夏登轰51分创骑士生涯新高 128:119挫溜马 生涯第26次50+超越高比
title.zh_hant: 夏登轟51分創騎士生涯新高 128:119挫溜馬 生涯第26次50+超越高比

summary.en: James Harden scored 51 points to lead the Cleveland Cavaliers to a 128-119 win over the Indiana Pacers in an NBA Cup group game. It was the 18-year veteran's 26th career 50-point game, moving him past the late Kobe Bryant into third place all-time, and his first 50-point game since scoring 55 for the Los Angeles Clippers against Charlotte on November 22, 2025. It was also his best scoring game with the Cavaliers since joining near the trade deadline in February, surpassing the 36 he scored against Chicago last season. Harden shot 15 of 26 from the field, including 7 of 11 from three-point range, and made all 14 of his free throws, adding six rebounds and six assists. Donovan Mitchell added 20 points and Peyton Watson scored 15 for the Cavaliers, who have won three of four and improved to 2-1 in East Group B. For the Pacers, Ivica Zubac had 21 points and 10 rebounds and Pascal Siakam also scored 21, as Indiana lost its third straight and fell to 1-2. Cleveland led 74-73 early in the third quarter before a 21-4 run opened up a 23-point lead; the Pacers fought back to within two possessions with 2:03 left before Mitchell steadied the win.
summary.zh_hans: 占士夏登攻入51分，带领克里夫兰骑士在NBA杯分组赛以128:119击败印第安纳溜马。这是这位征战18季的老将生涯第26次单场50分或以上，超越已故高比拜仁，升上史上第三位；亦是他自去年11月22日为快艇对黄蜂攻入55分以来首次50+，更是他2月交易截止日前加盟骑士以来得分最高一仗，超越上季对公牛的36分。夏登26投15中，包括三分球11投7中，罚球14罚全中，另有6个篮板及6次助攻；米曹得20分，屈臣得15分，骑士近4仗赢3仗，NBA杯东岸B组2胜1负。溜马方面，祖巴得21分及10个篮板，西亞卡亦得21分，球队3连败，分组赛1胜2负。骑士在第三节初段一度领先74:73，随后打出一波21:4，最多领先23分；溜马末段反扑追至只差两个回合，米曹及时得分稳住胜局。

title.en: Gilgeous-Alexander drops 40 as Thunder rally from 16 down to beat Pelicans 126-120
title.zh_hans: SGA轰40分 雷霆126:120反胜鹈鹕 落后16分大逆转
title.zh_hant: SGA轟40分 雷霆126:120反勝鵜鶘 落後16分大逆轉

summary.en: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 40 points as the Oklahoma City Thunder rallied in the fourth quarter to beat the New Orleans Pelicans 126-120 in an NBA Cup group game. The Thunder trailed by 16 points in the third quarter before storming back; Gilgeous-Alexander's three-point play with 34.8 seconds left made it 124-116, and he scored 21 of his 40 after half-time for his fourth 40-point game of the season. Spanish rookie Aday Mara added 22 points and 16 rebounds as the Thunder improved to 2-1 in West Group B. The Pelicans, who led 98-92 going into the fourth quarter, fell to 0-3 and are eliminated from quarter-final contention, their 10th straight regular-season defeat against the Thunder.
summary.zh_hans: 沙伊·吉尔杰斯-亚历山大攻入40分，带领奥克拉荷马城雷霆在NBA杯分组赛以126:120反胜新奥尔良鹈鹕。雷霆第三节一度落后16分，第四节反扑；亚历山大在完场前34.8秒完成「三分打」，将比分拉开至124:116，全场21分来自下半场，今季第四次单场40+。西班牙新秀艾戴·马拉得22分及16个篮板，雷霆NBA杯西岸B组2胜1负；鹈鹕第四节开始时还领先98:92，最终0胜3负，分组出局，对雷霆常规赛10连败。
summary.zh_hant: 沙伊·吉爾傑斯-亞歷山大攻入40分，帶領奧克拉荷馬城雷霆在NBA盃分組賽以126:120反勝新奧爾良鵜鶘。雷霆第三節一度落後16分，第四節反撲；亞歷山大在完場前34.8秒完成「三分打」，將比分拉開至124:116，全場21分來自下半場，今季第四次單場40+。西班牙新秀艾戴·馬拉得22分及16個籃板，雷霆NBA盃西岸B組2勝1負；鵜鶘第四節開始時還領先98:92，最終0勝3負，分組出局，對雷霆常規賽10連敗。

summary.en: Anthony Davis scored 36 points and grabbed 11 rebounds as the Washington Wizards beat the Chicago Bulls 98-94 on the road for their second straight win. Washington trailed by as many as 15 before Chicago managed just nine points in the third quarter; the Wizards then seized control with a 12-0 run in the fourth to lead 89-78 with 7:31 left. Rookie AJ Dybantsa added 20 points, 10 rebounds and six assists for his second straight double-double, and Trae Young scored 16. Norman Powell led Chicago with 16 points.

title.en: Franz Wagner's 35 points capped by a game-winner as Magic edge Nets 113-111 to stay perfect in NBA Cup
title.zh_hans: 华格拿35分绝杀篮网 魔术113:111险胜 NBA杯3战全胜
title.zh_hant: 華格拿35分絕殺籃網 魔術113:111險勝 NBA盃3戰全勝

summary.en: Franz Wagner scored 35 points, including a game-winning jumper with 2.4 seconds left, as the Orlando Magic beat the Brooklyn Nets 113-111 in an NBA Cup group game on Friday night. It was the first time Wagner faced his older brother Mo Wagner, his teammate for the past five seasons in Orlando before Mo joined the Nets as a free agent in July; Franz stepped back and hit a 14-foot jumper near the Nets bench, and Brooklyn's Julius Randle missed a 28-foot three-pointer at the buzzer. Wagner shot 13 of 25 from the field and 7 of 9 from the free-throw line, adding five rebounds and seven assists. Desmond Bane finished with 21 points and Nikola Vucevic added 15 off the bench as the Magic won five of their last six and improved to 3-0 in NBA Cup group play. For the Nets, Randle scored 27 points and nine rebounds and Danny Wolf added 20, as Brooklyn lost its fourth straight and fell to 1-6 at home. Orlando had trailed by as many as 15 points before the game swung back and forth late; Wendell Carter Jr. tied it at 111-111 with a putback layup with 31 seconds left before Wagner hit the winner.

Bayern suffered a further blow in the 20th minute when Ballon d'Or winner Harry Kane limped off with an ankle injury; substitute Tom Bischof set up Nathaniel Brown to equalise in the 37th minute. Michael Olise was also withdrawn at half-time with a knock, while Jamal Musiala returned in the 70th minute for his first appearance since mid-September. Cologne have now gone five games without a win but took a valuable point, while Bayern extended their unbeaten run to 10 games.

George Russell joins Verstappen on the front row, with Lando Norris and Isack Hadjar on the second row. McLaren's Oscar Piastri drops from seventh to 17th after a 10-place grid penalty. Both Ferraris missed Q3, with Charles Leclerc 11th and Lewis Hamilton 12th. The race starts at 8pm local time on Saturday in Las Vegas.

summary.en: Carlos Alcaraz eased past Flavio Cobolli 6-4, 6-1 at the ATP Finals in Turin on Friday, brushing off hamstring concerns to complete an unbeaten group campaign and book a semi-final against Ben Shelton on Saturday. Daniil Medvedev later beat Frances Tiafoe 6-3, 6-4 in their winner-takes-all clash to snatch the final semi-final berth and set up a meeting with world No. 1 Alexander Zverev. Alcaraz, who had an MRI scan on his left thigh on Thursday, needed just over an hour to dismiss Cobolli, while Medvedev reached the semi-finals for the fourth time and first since 2023.
